name: Origami Glacier Bay
description: A glacial bay where icebergs are folded like giant origami sculptures and penguins waddle across creased ice.
prompt: A single surreal landscape of a glacier bay where icebergs are folded like giant origami sculptures, with sharp creases and translucent blue-white paper textures. Penguins and seals navigate the geometric ice, a paper boat sails through calm water. Pale arctic light, soft mist, crisp shadows, elegant impossible-world aesthetic, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: Somewhere between ice and paper, a whole world folds into place. Would you explore this creased coastline?
